$comment: The apps on the framework that carry the control surface (build apps-control-surface, Brett Nov 3 2026: "Put EVERY app on the API, MCP and CLI"). Read by core/engines/console-commands.mjs (apps_list, which app a word names, the address to wake an app at) and the console server's control surface broker. `id` = the app's axf.manifest.json app.id (what its client reports); `aliases` = the words a person uses for it. An app not listed here still works the moment its client says hello (it shows under its own id); listing it gives it a name, a wake address and a place in apps_list while it is closed.
